content: VP of Infrastructure James Morrison has resigned. Lisa Park promoted as interim replacement.
Lisa Park evaluating alternative GPU cloud providers. RFP issued to 3 vendors.
GPU utilization dropped from 82% to 48% over 4 weeks. Training jobs migrating to competitor.
No executive contact in 90+ days. QBR requests unanswered.
Sev-1: Complete rack failure in Pod 3. 4-hour outage affecting 120 GPU nodes.
Sev-1: Power distribution unit failure. 2-hour outage. Second major incident in 3 weeks.
CTO Michael Torres escalated to our VP of Sales. Demanded reliability improvement plan within 2 weeks.
RMA rate crossed 2.5% threshold (was 0.8% in Oct). MTBF dropped to 4200 hours (target: 8000).
Q4 earnings miss. Board mandated 15% OpEx reduction across all departments.
Planned Phase 2 expansion ($2.1M) put on indefinite hold. CFO froze all new infrastructure spend.
Capacity reduction: decommissioning 50 GPU nodes (200 → 150). Workloads consolidating.
CFO requested pricing comparison with 2 competitors for renewal negotiation leverage.
GPU utilization trending down: 78% → 71% over 6 weeks. Some workloads moved to cloud.
Multiple tickets about training job failures. Completion rate dropped from 94% to 87%.
Last QBR was Oct 2025. Three scheduling attempts declined or no-showed.
Major restructure: Engineering team reorganized. Alex Nguyen's role changed, reduced authority.
Capacity utilization at 91%. Queuing delays increasing for training jobs.
Expansion proposal ($800K) submitted in Dec. Finance requested ROI analysis, no response since.
PB-02 (Ops Stability) triggered. Dedicated support engineer assigned. Weekly health check calls started.
Health score improved from 41 to 58. RMA rate stabilized. MTBF trending up.
Health reached 67. Two consecutive weeks above at-risk threshold. Champion re-engaged.
CFO approved $1.2M expansion budget for Q3. AI initiative requires 80 additional GPU nodes.
CTO agreed to be a reference customer. Featured in case study and keynote at industry conference.
Phase 2 expansion completed. 40 new GPU nodes online. ARR increased from $1.2M to $1.6M.
Time-to-first-workload: 3 days (benchmark: 14 days). Fastest onboarding in portfolio history.
GPU utilization reached 65% in 4 weeks. 12 training jobs running concurrently.
